title: Separate comparator initial gain from transient delay
hypothesis: Return a short gain-scaling derivation when the internal-node capacitance changes.
why_hard: Terra/max receives 1/4 in each of three published judge evaluations; outputs use 42604, 26909 and 12636 tokens. The disagreement is gain versus charging slope/delay, not a missing answer. Screening: Potentially one crux, but initial gain needs an operational definition. A time-based answer must not be failed against an event-based reference without stating that distinction.
next_action: Define the measurement event and inspect source waveforms; independently reproduce the gain/delay distinction before selecting a fresh instance.
notes: Independent verifier: Specify the comparison event, then compare a transient calculation with charge-balance analysis. The published capacitance-delay netlist was read, not executed. Easy baseline: At a fixed common-mode excursion both integration time and capacitance scale together; at fixed elapsed time they need not. New source-screening card, outside the frozen original 100. No local model trial; not submission-ready.
